categories.main_business_segments: Beijing YanDong Micro Electronic Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: manufacturing and services, and products and solutions. The manufacturing and services segment focuses on wafer fabrication, including power devices and ASICs, providing foundry services. The products and solutions segment offers discrete devices and analog integrated circuit solutions, targeting consumer electronics, new energy, power electronics, and smart terminals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs a Foundry+IDM hybrid model, integrating chip design, manufacturing, packaging, and testing. It utilizes advanced semiconductor manufacturing technologies including 6-inch, 8-inch, and 12-inch wafer production lines with process nodes such as 65nm and developing 28nm lines. Core technologies include power device fabrication (e.g., trench MOSFET, TMBS), SiC and SiN silicon photonics, BCD process platforms, MEMS, and high-voltage CMOS. The company emphasizes innovation in trench gate power devices, IGBT, SiC MOSFETs, and silicon photonics with proprietary process development and patent protection.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad range of customers in consumer electronics, new energy sectors, power electronics, automotive electronics, and industrial control. Key markets include data centers, AI, optical communication, photovoltaic, and automotive applications. It maintains long-term relationships with domestic leading enterprises and targets emerging fields such as 5G, AI chips, and silicon photonics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered and primarily operates in Beijing, China, with its production facilities located in Beijing and Sichuan. Its market coverage is mainly domestic within China, with some international sales. The company’s shareholder base and strategic partners are predominantly Chinese state-owned and investment entities.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing YanDong Micro Electronic operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the semiconductor supply chain. It is a wafer foundry and IDM, providing wafer fabrication, chip design, packaging, and testing services. It acts as both a manufacturer for external customers (foundry) and a producer of its own integrated circuits and discrete devices.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment, with 19.91% of revenue allocated to research and development in 2024. Strategic R&D focuses include advancing 28nm to 65nm process technologies, silicon photonics, SiC power devices, high-voltage CMOS, and MEMS. It pursues innovation in power semiconductor devices, silicon photonics platforms, and analog ICs, supported by a strong patent portfolio and collaboration with academic and research institutions. The company also emphasizes smart manufacturing and lean management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of discrete semiconductor devices and analog ICs, wafer foundry services, and integrated solutions. The company also earns income from packaging and testing services. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but on direct sales and manufacturing contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: YanDong Micro is positioned as a leading domestic semiconductor manufacturer in China, recognized as one of the top ten power device companies by the China Semiconductor Industry Association. It competes in mature and emerging semiconductor markets, focusing on power devices, silicon photonics, and analog ICs. Its main competitors include domestic IDM and foundry companies, as well as international semiconductor manufacturers expanding in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.7 billion, a 19.87% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to reduced sales volume and price declines in high-stability and consumer products. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 178 million, reflecting a significant decline. Total assets grew by 30.16% to RMB 24.06 billion, driven by consolidation of controlled enterprises and capital investments. R&D spending increased by nearly 15%, supporting future growth. The company is in a growth and capacity expansion phase, with ongoing large-scale projects in advanced wafer fabrication.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: YanDong Micro emphasizes its integrated Foundry+IDM model, enabling efficient design-to-manufacturing transitions and high-quality product delivery. Its competitive differentiation lies in proprietary advanced process technologies, including silicon photonics, SiC power devices, and high-voltage CMOS platforms. The company offers high-reliability, high-performance semiconductor products tailored for demanding applications such as AI, data centers, automotive, and new energy. It also highlights its strong innovation capability, extensive patent portfolio, and strategic partnerships within China's semiconductor ecosystem.
